<thought>Search the template catalog for a forward reaction that forms a C‑C double bond while breaking a ketone carbonyl and a trimethylsilyl group, matching the Peterson olefination.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
